items.why: an agent works here under bypass permissions and the guards blocked four of its real commands this week, each correctly; what holds it off 10 is that they fail open by design and this repository says so
the four live blocks were all real refusals of real mistakes, so the 0 is discrimination under load rather than a probe set that happened to miss
the uncovered quarter is mostly error paths under shared/, which is the code that ships into repositories nobody here has seen and where an unexercised branch costs most

nine defects were available and the instrument put back none of them: every commit it sampled predates `scripts/check.py`, so a repository whose documented entry point is two weeks old cannot be replay-tested on its own history
25 check files across 7 places and the machinery gap closed; the 6% left is docs-shaped commits the type classifier did not exclude, not code arriving unverified
five checks required to merge on a one-author repository, so nothing reaches main unrun, and the second opinion now fails below 65 instead of below 0

6 of 12, and five of the six absences are correct here -- its skills, agents and commands are the plugin's, which rule 4 requires; the one real gap is the empty .claude/rules/, which 5.1 independently reports as six path-scoped sentences paid for on every turn
33 documents and every reference resolves, in a tree that renamed its own directories twice this month
all 24 were read and the two that were real got fixed; the reading is committed and expires exactly when its document changes, but nothing yet fails when the next one goes unread
one candidate, judged and dismissed with the query.py default it was compared against, and the dismissal is kept so nobody re-reads it
the openings left are in skill references rather than in the four files an agent loads while it works, which is where the twelve rewrites went
1140 tokens buys the three-identity table that decides where every file in this tree goes, and no prohibition on it restates a guard; six sentences are path-scoped and paid anyway
the one flag left is templates.md at 75% fenced, which is a file of templates -- the fences are the content; the size outlier went with the agent that was removed
